entries.title: Bags Weighed, but Never Labeled
entries.text: Bags moved down an automated line and were weighed correctly, but the labeling step never completed. Labels matter on a production line: product without them can't ship, so the line was effectively stopped at that step. Because the labeler and the PLC both sit on the plant network, the first question was whether the network had broken the conversation between them.
